claims.claim_text: The indexed Martin G Cohn probably is the American film editor Martin G. Cohn, 1893-1953, but the identifier-free index row does not conclusively establish the match.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A Library of Congress catalog record supplies the exact full name and middle initial, life dates and a dated film-editing credit.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable because the exact three-part name is distinctive and appears in an authoritative film record; no private identifier, rank, Box 133 record or direct OSS biography has been reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The 1920 film credit is unquestionably prewar but is too early to establish the immediate pre-OSS role.
claims.match_notes: The candidate is presented visibly as probable and excluded from default high-confidence analytics.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The Library of Congress identifies a Martin G. Cohn, 1893-1953, as a film editor and credits him on a 1920 film. The exact three-part indexed name is distinctive, but the Box 133 row has no rank, identifier, occupation or direct OSS biography, so the match remains probable.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 to confirm the film-editor identity and identify Martin G Cohn's last civilian employer and immediate pre-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier and exact Myron Cohn name select the only exact-name official Army merged-file row. It records Army entry on 22 October 1942 as a private in the Enlisted Reserve Corps and civilian-occupation code 001.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 and pre-1942 directories to identify Myron Cohn's employer, accounting specialty and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier disambiguates Theodore Cohn from thirteen other exact-name Army rows. The selected official record dates Army entry to 8 September 1942 as a private in the Enlisted Reserve Corps and records student status.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 and pre-1942 educational records to identify Theodore Cohn's institution, course of study and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier and exceptionally distinctive Trayone J Cojerian name select the only exact-name official Army merged-file row. It records Army entry on 19 October 1942 as a private and civilian-occupation code 475.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 and pre-1942 directories to identify Trayone J Cojerian's employer, machinist specialty and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies Owen S Coke with a short six-digit private identifier and no rank. That literal value was not padded or repaired and does not select an exact-name row in the complete Army merged-file scan. Exact-name OSS, CIA, military, employer, occupation, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory and archival searches produced no reliable identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 to determine the identifier system, full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment for Owen S Coke.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies no rank or identifier for Dorothy E Cokeley. The complete Army file has no exact-name row, and exact-name OSS, CIA, employer, occupation, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory and archival searches yielded only unsupported or chronologically incompatible namesakes.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 for Dorothy E Cokeley's full identity, personnel status, employer, occupation and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies no rank or identifier for Vassilia Cokinides. A 1950 Virginia newspaper names a law graduate with the exact rare name, but supplies no OSS, Box 133 or wartime bridge and no relevant pre-OSS employer. Variant-spelling, CIA, NARA, occupation, obituary, newspaper, institutional, directory and archival searches found no reliable additional link.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 to confirm whether the indexed person is the later National University Law School graduate and document her wartime identity, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier and exact printed Raymond T Col name select the only matching official Army merged-file row. It records Army entry on 29 August 1942 as a private in the Enlisted Reserve Corps and civilian-occupation code 001. The source spelling Col is preserved without correction.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 and pre-1942 directories to identify Raymond T Col's employer, accounting specialty, any documented surname variant and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 and pre-1941 directories to identify Hugo Colacicco's employer, machinist specialty and Army-to-OSS sequence.

research_attempts.next_action: Confirm the identity and later civilian chronology in Box 133.
